characters.name: Human (MakeHuman)
characters.description: A realistic rigged human with a real skin texture and a clip library (walk/run/idle/wave), generated with MakeHuman (MPFB 2). See scripts/blender/make-human.py.
characters.credit: Generated with MakeHuman / MPFB 2 (makehumancommunity.org); skin from the makehuman_system_assets pack — all CC0.

characters.name: Man (MakeHuman)
characters.description: A realistic adult male (gender=1.0, taller/broader build) with a real skin texture and the walk/run/idle/wave clip library. Generated with MakeHuman (MPFB 2); see scripts/blender/make-human.py.
characters.credit: Generated with MakeHuman / MPFB 2 (makehumancommunity.org); skin from the makehuman_system_assets pack — all CC0.

characters.name: Child (MakeHuman)
characters.description: A realistic child (age=0.16, shorter child proportions) with a real skin texture and the walk/run/idle/wave clip library. Generated with MakeHuman (MPFB 2); see scripts/blender/make-human.py.
characters.credit: Generated with MakeHuman / MPFB 2 (makehumancommunity.org); skin from the makehuman_system_assets pack — all CC0.

characters.name: Man in a suit (MakeHuman)
characters.description: A realistic man wearing real clothing geometry — a casual suit + shoes fitted and skinned to the same rig (three skinned meshes), each with its own CC0 texture. Walk/run/idle/wave clips. Generated with MakeHuman (MPFB 2); see scripts/blender/make-human.py.
characters.credit: Generated with MakeHuman / MPFB 2 (makehumancommunity.org); skin + clothing from the makehuman_system_assets pack — all CC0.

characters.name: Speaker (MakeHuman + mouth morph)
characters.description: A realistic human with a 'mouthOpen' morph target (blend shape) for lip-sync, plus the walk/run/idle/wave clips. Drive morph.mouthOpen from audio beats. Generated with MakeHuman (MPFB 2); see scripts/blender/make-human.py.
characters.credit: Generated with MakeHuman / MPFB 2 (makehumancommunity.org); skin + jaw-drop morph from MakeHuman data — all CC0.

characters.name: VRM avatar (CC0)
characters.description: A VRM 1.0 avatar (the web-3D humanoid format) — loaded via loadVrm, which parses the VRM humanoid bone map + license. Built CC0 from a MakeHuman human; walk/run/idle/wave clips. Drop in any VRM 0.x/1.0 file to load your own.
characters.credit: VRM 1.0 avatar generated CC0 by vsim from a MakeHuman / MPFB 2 human (makehumancommunity.org); VRM extension injected by scripts/make-vrm.mjs.

characters.name: Quadruped (Blender)
characters.description: A rigged four-legged creature (13-bone spine + neck/head + tail + four two-bone legs) with walk/trot gaits. vsim's own asset, generated headlessly by scripts/blender/make-quadruped.py — no third-party content.
characters.credit: Generated by vsim's scripts/blender/make-quadruped.py — MIT (no third-party assets).
